name: THE PIE WOMAN
note: Doc 07 #6. Pies of unstated provenance. Best R_DEAD bark in the game.

barks.R_SWINDLED: Pie. Half price for the newly poor.
barks.R_SURVEYED: That woman charged you two dollars to point at dirt. Pie.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Pie, Mr. Grubb. On the house. On the house today.
barks.R_LOST_DUEL: Pie. You’ll want the big one.
barks.R_WON_DUEL: Beat Deke Vessel! Pie’s still a nickel.
barks.R_TRUTH: Biggest lie ever told in this territory and he still buys the nickel pie.

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the pose and a derived one-pixel breath. Frames 2-4 are the three poses from the character sheet. `breaks` are SEPARATE actions chosen from a pool, each leaving the idle and returning to it -- not a routine played in order, which is what the eye catches.

migrationNote: ERRATA 54, x6. Was (150, 126) in the 320x144 play area. THE AMBIENT LAYER WAS NEVER MIGRATED: tools/migrate-play-area-x6.mjs is an ALLOWLIST -- "anything not on the list is left exactly as it was" -- and it measured "17 rooms, 140 rects". An ambient character is not a room, so nothing named these and nothing touched them. Every one of them stood in the sky, 13-15% down a 864-tall play area, for as long as errata 54 has been in force, and the game loaded and validated and drew them there.
placeNote: Forward into the lit mud, clear of the porch line. Was (2210, 657).

main_street_candidate.note: RESTAGED TWICE. She was at 2470,706 behind the hitching rail, on ground the frozen front-only rule took away. Then at 2205,845 -- which the coordinates called clear and the DEPLOYED FRAME did not: she stood inside the trough's x-span (1976-2236), the trough's near wall drew across her skirt and her basket sat inside its rim. She read as standing in the water. She now stands at 2380,845 on mud_near_2, 144 px east of the trough's east edge and clear of its whole span, in front of the hitching rail in the saloon's light -- the front side, which is the only side the frozen rule allows anyone to be on. Thad reaches her from the same band within her own unenlarged radius of 40. Human visual proof, not a coordinate assertion: renders/opening-set-retrofit/phase2a-production-main-street-candidate.png.

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

placementsNote: PHASE 1.5B/1.5D: LEGACY CONTEXT ONLY. On the Main Street candidate her shipping x,y lands inside the trough's footprint; placed on the far mud east of the trough's end, behind the rail, until Phase 2 recasts her. The shipping room's x,y is untouched.
